notablePrerequisites:
You do not control another Drake or have a Drake in your graveyard.
You control at least three artifacts.
description:
Cast Lumengrid Drake by paying {3}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a copy of the Lumengrid Drake spell.
The Lumengrid Drake copy enters, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Food Chain by exiling the Lumengrid Drake token, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent on creature spells.
Lumengrid Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
